name: Ghost Paste
description: A hacker collective's paste relay has resurfaced on the lab network. Find the service and recover the protected record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the relay record
tasks.description: The collective left a protected record on its paste relay. Find the service on the lab network and recover the record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Look over the relay's public surface for operational material the collective left behind.
Check whether an exposed backup contains account details, then identify how the relay asks clients to authenticate.
Use the account details from the backup to enter the control area, then read the protected record linked there.
